data.summary:
Errata replacing the Effect of [Untrammelled Ferocity](vsdata:ability/tyranids.crusher-stampede.untrammelled-ferocity). Until the phase ends, whenever one of your unit's models makes a **[Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or **[Fall Back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**, it may pass through models, except **TITANIC** models, and through sections of terrain 4″ tall or less. While doing so:

- it may enter enemy **[Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)**, but cannot end the move there
- it may also cross terrain sections taller than 4″, but if it does, roll a D6 once the unit finishes moving: on a 1, the unit is **[Battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock)**
